channel.title: Blog | Felipe Dias
channel.description: Experiments in AI and ECG, with methods, results and code.

item.title: Bias, Refusals and Language in Jev and GPT Decisions
item.description: An exploratory audit of Jev and GPT Decisions on all 38 closed FairLens questions in English and Portuguese, with complete recorded responses and reproducible analyses.

item.title: What Happens When Decision Models Read 21,799 ECG Images?
item.description: A follow-up to CODE Test: Jev and GPT Decisions on PTB-XL, with discrimination, calibration, sensitivity, specificity, precision and F1.

item.title: Can System-One AI Models Classify ECG Images?
item.description: Can two general-purpose decision models identify ECG abnormalities from images? A zero-shot evaluation on CODE Test using AUROC and probability calibration.
